# Freak

> Freak is an independent creative, data and AI agency. Head office in London, with global hubs in Barcelona and Abu Dhabi.

Freak (WeAreFreak Ltd, company 09308352) is an independent creative, data and AI agency. Head office at 22 Ash Avenue, London SE17 1HS, with hubs in Barcelona and Abu Dhabi, working for clients in over 100 countries. Contact studio@wearefreak.com.

## Capabilities

- Strategy. Research, data and planning that show where the growth is, then prove it worked.
  - Brand development and positioning
  - Market, competitor and SEO keyword research
  - Content optimisation and A/B testing
  - Multichannel data analytics and reporting
- Creative. Ideas built to travel, from a global master to every format and channel it needs.
  - Brand campaigns and key visuals
  - Social media content, always on and reactive
  - Product advertising for Amazon, Meta and retail media
  - Copywriting, art direction and illustration
- Production Studio. Our own studio, so ideas go from storyboard to finished asset without a handoff.
  - Photography and videography, on location or in our studio
  - Green screen, podcast and editing suites
  - 3D, CGI, motion graphics and animation
  - AI production, trained on rights cleared shoots
- Activation. Getting the work in front of the right people, in every market and language.
  - Global transcreation for more than 100 countries a year
  - Influencer campaigns, seeding and gifting
  - Community management and social reporting
  - Amazon Brand Stores and sales event content
- Technical. The platforms that keep a brand selling, built and looked after in house.
  - Website build, maintenance and SEO
  - Web apps and microsites, from product finders to 3D maps
  - Amazon catalogue management and listing fixes
  - Product content at scale for Amazon and retailer sites
- AI. Freak Lab, the AI tools we build in house for copy, content and reviews.
  - Image analysis with our neural marketing framework
  - Amazon copy from search and market data
  - Review moderation built on 20 years of Amazon knowledge
  - AI production with quality and compliance checks

## Specialisms

- [Amazon agency](https://www.wearefreak.com/capabilities/amazon-agency): Freak is a full service Amazon agency. Account setup, terms negotiation, catalogue management, A+ content, Brand Stores and advertising including Amazon DSP.
- [Content production](https://www.wearefreak.com/capabilities/content-production): Content creation agency and global transcreation partner. UGC, social media and video, localised for 100+ countries a year by our native speaking creatives.
- [Live production](https://www.wearefreak.com/capabilities/live-production): Videography and photography for campaigns, social and ecommerce. Casting, locations, crews, our own London studio and post production, all in house.
- [AI](https://www.wearefreak.com/ai): Freak Lab is our everytool AI kit for marketing. Image analysis from our neural marketing framework, Amazon copy and review moderation, built on paid data.
- [Influencer campaigns, seeding and gifting](https://www.wearefreak.com/capabilities/influencer-marketing): Influencer campaigns, creator seeding and gifting across Europe, North America and Australia. Vetted creators, clear contracts and #ad compliance.
- [Abu Dhabi](https://www.wearefreak.com/capabilities/abu-dhabi): Freak's Abu Dhabi hub brings campaigns, content, ecommerce and AI tools to brands across the MENA and APAC regions, backed by our global team of experts.

## Resource Centre

- [Resource Centre](https://www.wearefreak.com/resources): Guides, white papers and behind the scenes stories from Freak on Amazon, AI tools, ecommerce content, creators and the advertising rules brands work within.
- [AI shopping assistants like Alexa for Shopping are changing which brands get found](https://www.wearefreak.com/resources/amazon-alexa-for-shopping): Amazon replaced Rufus with Alexa for Shopping in May 2026. AI assistants answer with a few picks, not pages of results. What it means and how to adapt listings.
- [AI shopping agents trust brands that tell one product story everywhere](https://www.wearefreak.com/resources/product-content-ai-shopping-agents): AI shopping agents compare what Amazon, retailers and brand sites say about a product. How to give them one claims checked product story, in every market.
- [HFSS advertising rules in 2026, and what food brands can still do](https://www.wearefreak.com/resources/hfss-advertising-rules-2026): The UK's less healthy food ad rules have applied since 5th Jan 2026. What's banned on TV and online, what's exempt and how food brands are adapting.
- [Amazon listing copy built from evidence, and what it did for Feliway and Douxo](https://www.wearefreak.com/resources/amazon-listing-copy): How we write Amazon titles, bullets and descriptions from reviews, search and question data and approved claims, with the Feliway and Douxo examples.
- [Brand value, not compliance, is the biggest AI risk](https://www.wearefreak.com/resources/ai-brand-value-risk): Brands count AI's cost savings and miss its effect on revenue. What Freak's impact assessments found, the rules now in force and six steps to use AI safely.
- [Reddit and AI search, and what still works after the crackdown](https://www.wearefreak.com/resources/reddit-seo-ai-search): Reddit, Google and ChatGPT all moved against brand seeding this summer. What changed, why planted posts stopped working and what still earns a mention.
- [How we score Amazon images before shoppers ever see them](https://www.wearefreak.com/resources/amazon-image-visual-engagement-framework): Shoppers decide in seconds. Freak's neural marketing framework scores Amazon images on five measures, from visual saliency to colour, and shows how to fix them.
- [Amazon review moderation, and how to protect your star rating](https://www.wearefreak.com/resources/amazon-review-moderation): Four star ratings drive Amazon sales and one early review can sink a launch. How Freak finds and reports reviews that break Amazon's guidelines.
- [Creator seeding that gets posts, not just parcels](https://www.wearefreak.com/resources/creator-seeding-process): Sending product to creators is easy. Getting posts back is the job. The nine stages, vetting checks and two tiers we use to run seeding and gifting.
- [The making of Mapping Glastonbury for the V&A](https://www.wearefreak.com/resources/making-mapping-glastonbury): How Freak built Mapping Glastonbury for the V&A, five 3D maps of the festival that link to more than 500 archive items, running in the browser on any phone.
- [Amazon A+ content that sells, and what we changed for Feliway](https://www.wearefreak.com/resources/amazon-a-plus-content-guide): How to plan Amazon A+ content and the image stack above it, from information hierarchy to testing, with the changes that doubled Feliway's sales.
- [From one shoot to every listing, planning an ecommerce product shoot](https://www.wearefreak.com/resources/ecommerce-product-shoot-planning): How to plan one product shoot for Amazon, retailers and social. The shot matrix, location, casting and product tests behind Freak's Hoover shoot.
- [UGC that works on Amazon and social, from brief to final cut](https://www.wearefreak.com/resources/ugc-for-amazon-and-social): How to brief, cast and cut UGC that works on TikTok, Reels and Amazon product pages, with usage rights agreed first and versions for organic and paid.

- [Evermix, Making Sound Resound](https://www.wearefreak.com/work/evermix): Evermix makes portable audio kit for artists, DJs and performers. It needed a brand as loud as the scene it sells into.
